scores.scale: Holistic judgment of observed emulated mobile experience: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable friction, 10 exceptional and consistently clear. Overall is not an arithmetic mean; win/loss is not a grade.

reasons.overall_mobile: Enough touch assistance and clear objectives to reach the boss and defeat it on the second attempt, with attractive atmosphere. Simultaneous threat response, aim, ammunition management and route control felt cumbersome in this interrupted landscape test. Both losses inform coverage, not the score by themselves.
reasons.controls: Large thumb controls, tap-to-aim and two-contact route/fire worked. Repeated TURN and changing route-facing compete for camera orientation. Defense timing was not mastered. Free movement/drag aim were not meaningfully assessed, so no full control-system certification.
reasons.gameplay: Memory recovery, windowed coils and return objective provided understandable progression and a second-attempt learning opportunity. Patrol attacks punished stationary firing. Route holds also compressed travel/recovery into passive stretches; effective cover/defensive rhythm remained unclear to me. Upload phase unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive cyan/amber palette, rain, wet ground, signage, weapon art and monumental circular machinery conveyed a strong mood in the inspected frames. Audio and smoothness were not assessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, route assist, map route, numbered coil statuses, automatic reload and actionable empty-ammo prompt were helpful. Prominent checkpoint retry could be confused with fresh restart, though START FRESH was separately legible and worked. Tool actions require another tray opening.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo, objective and coil status were readable. Handbook lower content clipped behind its fixed footer and required scrolling; small HUD captions, map legend and dense terminal telemetry demanded inspection at 844x390. Dark cover and coil faces took attention to distinguish under combat pressure.
